dog.description_text:
With her gentle soul and sweet heart, 10lb chihuahua mix Purl is a quiet gem looking for a loving home where she can shine! At 1.5 years old, Purl is a soft-spoken gal who takes a thoughtful approach to new surroundings. She is already a total star in her crate, hanging out and treating it as her peaceful haven.

Purl will thrive in a calm, cozy home where she can blossom at her own pace. With a little love, watching this sweet girl come out of her shell will be the most rewarding experience! Registered adopters interested in Purl can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
